from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper: its own title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper being parsed")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers from the provided collection that are cited in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
